title: Stutter-Invariance Metamorphic Audits for Text World-Model Rollouts

raw.stage1:
### Purpose
The contribution's purpose is to provide a principled way to audit the reliability of LLM text world-model rollouts. None of the prior papers explicitly address this objective. While papers like [1], [10], and [12] discuss reliability in LLMs, they focus on different aspects such as text-to-query applications, judge reliability, or general LLM judgment reliability, rather than auditing text world-model rollouts specifically. No prior paper establishes a substantively equivalent purpose.

### Mechanism
The mechanism formalizes a stutter-invariance metamorphic relation, where inserting state-preserving commands should not affect subsequent predictions. Papers [8], [11], [19], and [26] discuss stutter-invariance in temporal logic or model checking, but these are in the context of formal logic or automata theory, not metamorphic testing or LLMs. However, the primitive concept of stutter-invariance — ensuring that certain state-preserving modifications do not alter outcomes — is substantively equivalent across domains. Thus, the mechanism is covered by these prior works.

### Evaluation
The evaluation facet involves presenting the stutter-invariance relation as a formal metamorphic relation for text world models, without numeric metrics for the formalization itself. Papers [3], [6], [7], [18], and [20] discuss metamorphic testing and the formalization of metamorphic relations, including their use in testing systems without oracles. These works establish the evaluation design of formalizing metamorphic relations, even if applied to different systems or domains. Therefore, the evaluation design is covered.

### Domain
The domain is metamorphic testing of LLM text world models. Papers [6], [7], [18], and [20] address metamorphic testing broadly, but none specifically target LLM text world models. While [13] and [21] discuss LLMs and robustness evaluation, they do not focus on metamorphic testing. Thus, the domain is uncovered.
